units.source_text: 恋爱中的人，不应该另有新恋情，同时也不应该把新恋情向旧恋人坦白。

en.t: A person who is in love should not have a new love at the same time, nor should they confess that new love to their former lover.

units.source_text: 这一点，町子也是知道的。
然而有时候，人知道得太多也是会忘记的。

en.t: And yet sometimes, when people know too much, they still forget.

units.source_text: 有时候只对某个人忘记。

en.t: Sometimes they forget only when it comes to one particular person.

units.source_text: 那可能是因为太爱那个人，或是太信任那个人的缘故吧。

en.t: Perhaps that is because they love that person too much, or trust that person too much.

units.source_text: 因此，当鹿山说“町子你再怎样为自己辩解……”的时候，町子格外惊讶。

en.t: So when Kayama said, "Machiko, no matter how you try to justify yourself..." Machiko was especially startled.
